courses.subject: CHI
courses.title: Topics in Advanced Chinese
courses.description: Fourth-year Chinese readings on special topics. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. May be repeated for credit when the topics vary. Prerequisite: Chinese 320K with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Chinese 320K with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: CHI
courses.title: Chinese across Disciplines
courses.description: Reading and discussion of Chinese language materials related to the subject matter of another designated course in Asian studies. Meetings with the instructor will be devoted to the discussion of linguistic problems, literary features, and crucial passages. Individual instruction. May not be counted toward fulfillment of the foreign language requirement for any bachelor's degree. May be repeated for credit. Offered on the pass/fail basis only. Prerequisite: Upper-division standing, concurrent enrollment in an appropriate Asian studies course, and written consent of instructor on form obtained from the undergraduate adviser.
courses.prereqText: Upper-division standing, concurrent enrollment in an appropriate Asian studies course, and written consent of instructor on form obtained from the undergraduate adviser.
courses.excluded: fulfillment of the foreign language requirement for any bachelor's degree
courses.offering: Offered on the pass/fail basis only.

courses.prereqText: Chinese 320K with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: CHI
courses.title: Classical Chinese Poetry

courses.prereqText: Chinese 320K with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: CHI
courses.title: Conference Course in Chinese Language and Literature
courses.description: Supervised individual study of selected problems in Chinese language or literature. Conference course. May be repeated for credit. Prerequisite: Upper-division standing and written consent of instructor on form obtained from the undergraduate adviser.
courses.prereqText: Upper-division standing and written consent of instructor on form obtained from the undergraduate adviser.

courses.title: Conference Course in Chinese Language and Culture
